_about: Public-domain Philip Lindsley (1786-1855), Presbyterian minister, acting president of the College of New Jersey and president of the University of Nashville, for the Word Hoard: A Plea for the Theological Seminary at Princeton, a 1824 college chapel sermon, The Cause of Education in Tennessee, Educational Discourses, and volumes of his Works. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 106 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

lindsley-plea-princeton: A plea for the theological seminary at Princeton, N.J, vol. c.1 (Trenton : Printed by George Sherman, 1821)
lindsley-chapel-sermon-1824: A sermon, delivered in the chapel of the College of New-Jersey, August 15, 1824 (catalogued 1824)
lindsley-education-tennessee: The cause of education in Tennessee (catalogued 1833)
lindsley-educational-discourses: Educational discourses (Philadelphia, J.B. Lippincott & Co.; Nashville, W.T. Berry & Co., 1859)
lindsley-works-2: The works of Philip Lindsley (Philadelphia : J.B. Lippincott, 1866)
lindsley-works-3: The works of Philip Lindsley D.D., late president of the University of Nashville, vol. 1 (Philadelphia, J.B. Lippincott & Co.; Nashville, W.T. Berry & Co., 1859)
lindsley-works-4: The works of Philip Lindsley, D.D., formerly Vice-President and President Elect of the College of New Jersey, Princeton; and late President of the University of Nashville, Tennessee (Philadelphia : J.B. Lippincott, 1866)
